scientific_integrity.finding: Complete unrestricted-depth three-variable equivalence of the incidence graphs of all finite nontrivial symmetric 2-designs; sharp four-variable distinction between the Fano and complementary biplane incidence graphs.
scientific_integrity.first_public_date_interpretation: First exact-day verified public release of the primary finite-variable-logic source arXiv:1204.1990 (2012-04-09); not a publication date for the present finding.
limitations: Does not cover counting logic, four-variable equivalence, arbitrary nonsymmetric designs or trivial symmetric designs with v-k=1.
Finite tests corroborate but do not replace the symbolic proof.
Historical priority remains incompletely verified; independent mathematical audit not performed.
scientific_integrity.proof_basis: Dual incidence-matrix identity, eight ordered-pair types and uniform positive extension counts give an infinite three-pebble back-and-forth strategy. A four-cycle witnesses the variable-width boundary.

title: Three-variable collapse of nontrivial symmetric-design incidence graphs
